title: Tape 1: Logs hidden from core game files
claim: The tape speaker (an unnamed tester, credited only as 'QA') says she hid her logs away from the core gameplay files, in a protected place only a beta tester would look, hoping the next development team finds them before public release. The game holds malicious code her team could not contain or understand, the studio is shutting down for a reason other than budget, and the logs 'may not be in order'.
quote: This game has some kind of malicious code in it that we haven't been able to fully contain...or even understand for that matter. We're over budget and out of time.
location: Hidden tape #1 (cassette collectible; played in the Tape Room)

when.label: During the Virtual Experience's development (undated)
when.basis: Help Wanted gives no in-universe year; the tapes describe the first studio's development period

notes: She continues: 'But that's not the reason that we're shutting down.' and 'There are more, they may not be in order.' The speaker is never named in the game; 'Tape Girl' is a fan and wiki label (see hw-credits-tape-girl-qa).
